note: VIA Rail Canada routes that offer sleeping accommodations (cabins / berths). The gtfs-sleeper adapter keeps only feed routes whose route_long_name / route_short_name / route_id matches one of these (case/space/punctuation-insensitive). Several name/city-pair variants are listed because VIA's GTFS route naming should be confirmed against the live feed. Corridor day trains (Québec City–Windsor) are intentionally excluded.
